M004.label: favourable
M004.quote: Thus, the influences of the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 9th, 10th and 11th are so interrelated in this horoscope that they account for the immense wealth and power the Maharaja commanded.
M004.note: Also 'master of absolute power and unlimited wealth' in Remarks.

M012.label: favourable
M012.quote: Conclusion : The native is happily married to a devoted and chaste wife with religious propensities.

M020.label: mixed
M020.quote: The Dhana Yoga is well marked by the fact of Saturn's exaltation in the 10th house but this does not add the qualities needed to make one spiritually elevated.
M020.note: Raman credits wealth and publicity (line 13082) but judges his claimed spiritual mission as hollow; no clean single career verdict.

M028.label: favourable
M028.quote: Franco's horoscope is notable for the manner in which yogakaraka Saturn conferred the Rajayoga results in his Dasa.
M028.note: Head of state, Generalissimo, Caudillo in Saturn Dasa.

M036.label: afflicted
M036.quote: The debilitation and eclipse of the 7th lord Saturn and Mars in the 8th house resulted in the death of wife.

M044.label: afflicted
M044.quote: Note Mars as lord of the 6th and Saturn as lord of the 8th both afflicting Lagna point out the direction of his destiny — incarceration and death by hanging.

M052.label: afflicted
M052.quote: He was hanged under the same directional influences.

M060.label: mixed
M060.quote: are excellent Dhana Yogas favouring amassing of wealth, but as lord of the 11th (Mercury) is in the 12th, again aspected by the benefic Jupiter, he divested himself of almost all his property
M060.note: Wealth came (including a windfall in Venus Dasa) but he gave almost all of it away to charity.

M068.label: mixed
M068.quote: As a result of this affliction, Roosevelt was stricken with infantile paralysis at the end of Saturn Dasa. Some sort of Vipareetha Rajayvga has arisen by the very same combination
M068.note: Body afflicted (paralysis, 'reduced to a wreck') but the same combination raised him to the highest position; two-sided.

M076.label: afflicted
M076.quote: This is a very significant combination making the native a real Brahmachari and enabling him to observe celibacy, physically and mentally.
M076.note: Spouse denied (lifelong celibacy); Raman presents it as spiritually positive, but there is no marriage.

M084.label: afflicted
M084.quote: is an unfortunate combination which involved him in trying lawsuits, brought against him by the authorities for his 'obscene writings'.
M084.note: Enemies/litigation suffered; Raman also notes 'Ellis himself was not molested'.

M092.label: afflicted
M092.quote: That he was inconspicuous in the school and had meagre education is revealed by the 4th lord being Saturn

M108.label: afflicted
M108.quote: the native had defective sight till 1928, i.e., he could not see clearly during nights and he lost his vision completely in 1928
M108.note: Total blindness; Raman links both 2nd and 12th (eyes) to the loss.

M116.label: afflicted
M116.quote: Bhava is rendered weak with the result no children have been born to him either by the first or the second wife.

M124.label: favourable
M124.quote: the native married a second time after the death of the first. Both marriages were fairly happy.
M124.note: First wife died and there were tiffs with a touchy wife, but Raman's verdict on marital happiness is 'fairly happy'; arguably mixed.

M132.label: afflicted
M132.quote: These combinations explain the fact of his parents having died early.

M140.label: afflicted
M140.note: Also 'shot to death in Saturn Dasa, Mercury Bhukti'.

M148.label: afflicted
M148.quote: These afflictions rendered the native issueless.

M156.label: afflicted
M156.quote: Domestically the poet was not happy, on account of the death of his wife and children. Of his five children, two were the survivors.

M164.label: afflicted
M164.quote: The native of Chart No. 253 has weak eyes which water under even slight strain.

M172.label: favourable
M172.quote: The subject is quite well off in life and enjoys a monthly salary of Rs. 1,500.

M180.label: mixed
M180.quote: gave Hitler immense material possessions and power. The evil side of Saturn's influence manifested in the final collapse of the dictator — especially because Saturn is in the 10th house
M180.note: Cited line was only the chart header; Raman's conclusion: rose to rule (Chancellor) but final collapse.

M188.label: mixed
M188.quote: The native had 6 brothers (and sisters born) out of whom three died early in life.
M188.note: Many siblings, half died early: explicitly two-sided.

M204.label: favourable
M204.quote: are important factors conducive to the long life of the father. The native's father died in the former's 41st year
M204.note: Father lived until the native was 40.

M212.label: favourable
M212.quote: In Jupiter Dasa, Jupiter Bhukti, the native not only had dips in the Ganges but also in many other sacred rivers and visited a number of holy places.

M220.label: none
M220.note: Raman's 4th-house remarks concern education (favourable: brilliant scholar, several languages, line 9483); nothing concluded on happiness/domestic comfort.

M228.label: favourable
M228.quote: Sri Chaitanya was very beautiful and was hence called Gauranga or fair-complexioned.

M236.label: favourable
M236.quote: Mars dominant in the 10th, we have indeed the General of the Army.

M244.label: none
M244.note: Raman only times the father's death (1930, native aged ~34) by dasa; no judgment that the matter is good or bad.

M252.label: none
M252.note: Nothing on virility; 7th-house remarks concern the wife's death.

M260.label: favourable
M260.quote: All these combined together denote immense immovable possessions.

M268.label: favourable
M268.quote: The Jupiter-Mars influence denotes property, wealth and prosperity, a happy home and peaceful and successful domestic surroundings — though the martian aspect has got its own evil effect to produce.
M268.note: Small caveat about Mars, but the verdict leans clearly favourable.

M276.label: none
M276.note: Nothing about ears or throat; 3rd-house remark is about siblings (sole surviving of nine), and the cancer's site is not stated.

M284.label: favourable
M284.quote: A student of astrology cannot but be impressed by the strength par excellence of Lagna, the 9th and 10th houses.
M284.note: Founded a kingdom, crowned; Adhi Yoga 'made him stand on a lofty pedestal' (5050).

M292.label: mixed
M292.quote: gave an exalted father— the native was born to royal parents.
M292.note: Explicitly two-sided: exalted royal father (7983) but the afflictions 'deprived the native of his father very early in life' (7987; about age 4.5, 8253). Could be read as afflicted for the native.

M300.label: afflicted
M300.quote: Ill-health and financial troubles were too much for him.

M308.label: afflicted
M308.quote: Pitrukaraka, Sun, afflicted by Rahu s association and the 9th lord being aspected by Mars, rendered the native fatherless at an early age.

M316.label: favourable
M316.quote: Note the native acquired a fine car in Jupiter Dasha Venus Bhukti and a decent house in Jupiter Dasha Mars Bhukti.
